Added new /app/backend/tests/test_meera_refactor.py = 5/5 (admin Meera create_contests via chat, public chat cannot create, /api/production/upcoming-draws shape, /api/admin/draw still creates winner+notification, meera public 'How does GameZoo work?' returns non-empty reply with no create action executed). Frontend: Home / renders hero-banner + hero-video + both hero CTAs; only console errors are the two expected anonymous 401s for /api/auth/me and /api/users/notifications. Admin login (bachanta8@gmail.com / Herts@910022) via /admin/login → lands on /admin, Dashboard cards render, no console errors. When logged in on public /, both data-testid='header-user-menu' AND data-testid='notifications-bell' are visible (previous iteration_2 minor gap now closed). Meera chat launcher opens the panel; sending 'How does GameZoo work?' streams a proper multi-paragraph reply. No React duplicate-key warnings observed. critical_code_review_comments: deps.py extraction is clean — single AsyncIOMotorClient at import time, get_db() returns shared handle, db_ref alias preserved for back-compat. No circular-import risk anymore.

services/meera_actions.py: dispatch table + per-action handlers dropped meera_routes.py from 434 to 164 lines and each handler is <25 LoC. All handlers catch expected errors internally and return {ok:false,error:...}; only unexpected exceptions bubble to dispatch_action wrapper — good defensive style.

draw_service.py using secrets.choice is the right upgrade (was previously random.choice — flagged in iter2 review). Verified via test_meera_refactor.TestAdminDrawStillWorks that draws still succeed and create a Winner + notification.

AuthContext.js useMemo(value) + useCallback methods will prevent unnecessary re-renders in downstream consumers (Header, NotificationsBell, MeeraChat). Verified: no infinite-loop console warnings during login flow.
MeeraChat.jsx stable message ids: verified — no React 'duplicate key' warnings after sending message and receiving reply.
CSP meta tag: connect-src includes https:/wss:, so REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL fetches + WebSocket-based hot reload still work. Verified home + admin dashboard load fine.

Minor: tests/backend_test.py and test_scheduler_notifications.py still fall back to hard-coded BASE_URL/admin creds when envs are unset — acceptable for local dev but flagged for hardening (should use pytest.skip if env missing in CI).
